notes.title: Season Match 3 updated and achievements added!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that an update to Season Match 3 has been released! The major changes are:
- fixed issues with Mac version.
- achievements available and unlockable on Steam! Now you can show your friends your progress in rescuing the Months!
